8. Jack down the-hub1.
9. Repeat steps 3–8 for r2 on the-hub2 (loosen nuts2, jack up, remove w2 to boot, inflate r2, mount r2, tighten nuts2, jack down).
10. Verify w1 and w2 are in boot and boot remains open until stowing complete; close boot only after all stowing.
